summary: Checkbox and Switch gain labelPlacement ("end" default, "start" = the settings row: full width, label first, control pinned to the end) and description (body-sm muted under the label, inside the <label> so it is part of the hit target). The description is announced as the input's description: the name is pinned to the label text with aria-labelledby so a long description is never read as the name, and a caller's own aria-describedby is kept. With a description the row aligns to the top and the control sits on the label's first line; placement is visual only (flex-row-reverse), so the input stays before the control for every peer-* selector and RTL mirrors with the text (#9; approved on the Audit #9 sheet).
